We are Traxa, a supply chain visibility company that uses key point locations and community driven logistics asset tracki

properties.name: Traxa
properties.description:
We are Traxa, a supply chain visibility company that uses key point locations and community driven logistics asset tracking. Our focus begins with bringing visibility to the global positioning of intermodal shipping containers (TEUs), which transport 90% of the world’s trade and are the backbone of the global supply chain. 

Supply chain visibility is consistently operating in a state of crisis, with only 6% of companies reporting they have full visibility of their own supply chain. For the global supply chain as a whole the visibility is even worse, as the majority of data is either not collected or trapped in silos within companies. the effects of this are cascading and impact everything from sustainability to global poverty and the everyday headaches of millions who are trying to run and stock their businesses.

Our model is simple and effective, We crowd source supply chain data using automated capture devices and a play-and-earn-inspired experience. Then, we make that data available to all the shippers, carriers and companies that need it helping them make informed and effective decisions for their businesses.

entity.description:
We are Traxa, a supply chain visibility company that uses key point locations and community driven logistics asset tracking. Our focus begins with bringing visibility to the global positioning of intermodal shipping containers (TEUs), which transport 90% of the world’s trade and are the backbone of the global supply chain. 

Supply chain visibility is consistently operating in a state of crisis, with only 6% of companies reporting they have full visibility of their own supply chain. For the global supply chain as a whole the visibility is even worse, as the majority of data is either not collected or trapped in silos within companies. the effects of this are cascading and impact everything from sustainability to global poverty and the everyday headaches of millions who are trying to run and stock their businesses.

Our model is simple and effective, We crowd source supply chain data using automated capture devices and a play-and-earn-inspired experience. Then, we make that data available to all the shippers, carriers and companies that need it helping them make informed and effective decisions for their businesses.

entity.name: InterProModal
entity.description:
InterProModal is a full-stack Transportation Management System (TMS) being built for drayage carriers and intermodal brokers.

The drayage industry has long relied on spreadsheets, phone calls, and fragmented tools that create costly delays, compliance risks, and missed revenue. InterProModal was founded to change that.

Our platform connects dispatch, drivers, and data into one seamless workflow:

End-to-End Operations: Manage orders, dispatch, delivery, billing, and settlements in a single system.

Driver Mobile App: iOS/Android app with job assignments, digital inspections (DVIR), proof of delivery, and in-app chat.

Fleet Maintenance (LogIQ): Comprehensive asset management for trucks, trailers, chassis, and equipment. Includes preventive maintenance scheduling, telematics integration, automated recalls, expense tracking, and predictive analytics.

Advanced Tire Tracking: Monitor every tire across your fleet by serial number, tread depth, position history, and wear patterns. Our predictive models flag issues like misalignment or balance problems before they cause blowouts or downtime, reducing costs and improving safety.

Finance & Compliance: Automated invoicing, QuickBooks integration, and reminders for licenses, registrations, and safety compliance.

AI & Automation: OCR for documents, predictive alerts, and workflow automation to cut manual work.

We’re already live with our first beta customer for LogIQ and have multiple carriers signed on with letters of intent. Our roadmap includes dispatch and billing modules in 2026, followed by advanced AI automation and broker tools.

Our mission is simple: modernize drayage logistics with real-time visibility, smarter automation, and integrated tools that help carriers and brokers operate more efficiently.

Whether you run a 5-truck fleet or manage hundreds of drivers, InterProModal helps you reduce downtime, invoice faster, and keep your customers informed.

Here, the customer also pays per freight booking, supplemented by a monthly subscription for the customized version of LogiSnap.

We don’t just track freight. We give importers the tools to predict, prioritize, and communicate availability — before problems become failures.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

We are Traxa, a supply chain visibility company that uses key point locations and community driven logistics asset tracking. Our focus begins with bringing visibility to the global positioning of intermodal shipping containers (TEUs), which transport 90% of the world’s trade and are the backbone of the global supply chain. 

Supply chain visibility is consistently operating in a state of crisis, with only 6% of companies reporting they have full visibility of their own supply chain. For the global supply chain as a whole the visibility is even worse, as the majority of data is either not collected or trapped in silos within companies. the effects of this are cascading and impact everything from sustainability to global poverty and the everyday headaches of millions who are trying to run and stock their businesses.

Our model is simple and effective, We crowd source supply chain data using automated capture devices and a play-and-earn-inspired experience. Then, we make that data available to all the shippers, carriers and companies that need it helping them make informed and effective decisions for their businesses.

entity.name: Gnosis Freight
entity.description:
Gnosis Freight is an AI-native global freight operating system built for execution, enabling enterprise shippers and logistics providers to automate the end-to-end containerized freight lifecycle across ocean, port, rail, and inland transportation. At its core is a proprietary, sovereign data infrastructure that originates, validates, and structures logistics data directly from primary sources, including ports, terminals, ocean carriers, and Class I railroads, rather than relying on third-party aggregators or inferred visibility models. This foundation powers agentic AI that automates decision-making and workflows, resolving exceptions in real time. It also enables precise and timely milestone tracking, accurate ETA predictions, and end-to-end execution visibility at the shipment, order, and SKU level. 

 
Built on Gnosis’s Container Lifecycle Management® platform, the system enables operators to resolve exceptions faster, coordinate across stakeholders, and proactively mitigate cost drivers such as demurrage and detention. Gnosis also supports invoice audit and reconciliation, linking financial outcomes directly to operational events. Gnosis integrates seamlessly with ERP, TMS, WMS, SCM, and financial systems, delivering rapid deployment and time-to-value for enterprise BCOs, forwarders, drayage operators, and ocean carriers.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.
